criteria.text: Retain the existing profile-list/inspector arrangement and selection flow. Focus changes on each profile's settings, functions, and action presentation.
criteria.test_id: editor hierarchy, save/cancel and profile switching keep drafts on their original profile

criteria.text: Make the selected profile easy to understand at a glance: clear identity/status, meaningful section hierarchy, aligned labels/controls, readable descriptions, consistent spacing, and restrained visual treatment.
criteria.reason: Visual acceptance by AJ is required for the redesigned profile inspector.

criteria.text: Give identity/instructions, provider/model/account, delegation, availability/defaults, capabilities, and permissions coherent groups with plain-language explanations where needed. Frequently used controls should be easy to find; advanced details should remain discoverable without overwhelming the editor.
criteria.test_id: editor hierarchy, save/cancel and profile switching keep drafts on their original profile

criteria.text: Make long MCP/tool and skill lists manageable through clear grouping, selection summaries, and filtering or disclosure as appropriate. Preserve complete access to individual choices and communicate inherited/explicit selections accurately.
criteria.test_id: capability summaries, disclosure, filtering and bulk edits retain individual choices

criteria.text: Provide understandable controls for common permission choices rather than requiring raw JSON for ordinary edits. Preserve full existing policy semantics, including inheritance, per-tool patterns, and advanced/unknown entries; retain an explicit advanced editing path where necessary and never silently flatten or discard policy data.
criteria.test_id: unknown keys, inherited markers, advanced values and lexemes survive a targeted edit verbatim

criteria.text: Place profile-level actions consistently, with clear distinction between normal editing, immediate actions, and destructive actions. Preserve all existing profile functions and their authorization/confirmation requirements.
criteria.test_id: create, duplicate and back also protect a dirty draft; rename waits for Save

criteria.text: Make save/cancel, unsaved changes, validation, saving, success, and failure states unambiguous. Switching profiles must not silently discard edits or apply them to the wrong profile.
criteria.test_id: canonical fixture: pending save blocks switching and a failure retains the original draft for retry

criteria.text: Preserve actual live behavior and persistence for each setting. Fixture-only controls must not be presented as working live functionality.
criteria.reason: UNVERIFIED: no automated live-backend persistence test was authored in this run.

criteria.text: Ensure keyboard navigation, focus, labels, read-only states, long content, and smaller windows remain usable; sticky actions must not cover fields.
criteria.test_id: small windows, 200 percent zoom equivalent, RTL and long text keep controls reachable above the footer
